title: A target named M31 with unset 0,0 coordinates passes validation, and the Slew node confirms in green that it 'Will use target: M31'
what_happened: Added a Target node and typed 'M31' into Target Name. RA/Dec stayed at their 0.0000/0.0000 defaults - there is no name resolution anywhere in the target editor. The tree card then rendered 'M31 / RA 00h 00m 00s Dec +00d 00' 00"'. The Slew node's Properties panel showed a green check and 'Will use target: M31 / 00h 00m 00.0s +00d 00' 00"'. 'Frame target' opened a dialog titled 'Frame target - M31' showing the sky at RA 0.0000h Dec 0.000 deg (Pisces, not Andromeda) with no way to search or fix the coordinates. Pre-Flight Validation raised 9 issues and not one of them was about the coordinates; it only complains when RA is outside 0-24 or Dec outside +/-90 (target_rules.dart:15-35). The DB stored raHours 0.0, decDegrees 0.0 with targetName 'M31'. Running this points the mount at a random patch of sky all night.
expected: Either resolve the name to coordinates (the app clearly can: the bundled 'DSLR M31' starter carries RA 00h 42m 44s Dec +41d 16' 08"), or refuse: a target at exactly 0,0 that the user never typed should be a validation ERROR, and the Slew node must not display a green confirmation for it.
repro: Sequencer > Builder > palette 'Target' > + . In Properties set Target Name = M31, leave RA/Dec. Read the tree card and the 'Frame target' dialog. Add a Slew to Target node and read its Properties. Press Start and read the whole Pre-Flight list.
evidence: /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-21-m31.png (M31 with RA/Dec 0.0000), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-22-frame.png ('Frame target - M31' at RA 0.0000h Dec 0.000), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-23-slew2.png (green 'Will use target: M31 / 00h 00m 00.0s'), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-24-preflight.png + 25-pf1/pf2/pf3 (no coordinate issue), DB: TargetHeader properties {"targetName":"M31","raHours":0.0,"decDegrees":0.0}
proposed_fix: Add a TargetCoordinatesUnset rule (error) for raHours==0 && decDegrees==0 with a hint pointing at the resolver. Add name resolution to the Target properties panel using the same targets DAO / catalog path the Quick-Start Wizard uses, and gate the Slew node's green 'Will use target' confirmation on the target actually having coordinates.
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced in full. Added a Target node, typed 'M31' into Target Name; RA/Dec stayed 0.0000/0.0000 with no resolver anywhere in the panel, and the tree card rendered 'M31 / RA 00h 00m 00s Dec +00d 00' 00"' (sbv-35-m31.png). Added Slew to Target: its Properties show a green check on a green field reading 'Will use target: M31 / 00h 00m 00.0s +00d 00' 00"' (sbv-37-slew.png). 'Frame target' opened 'Frame target - M31' at RA 0.0000h Dec 0.000 with no search affordance (sbv-44-frame.png). Pre-Flight Validation returned 1 error + 3 warnings - Simulation info, No Exposures, No Mount Connected, No Guider Connected, Guider Not Connected - and nothing about the coordinates (sbv-39/40/41/42). Code confirms: target_rules.dart TargetCoordinatesRule (lines 6-43) only rejects raHours outside [0,24) and decDegrees outside [-90,+90]; grep across providers/sequence/rules found no raHours==0/decDegrees==0 check; target_node_properties.dart (468 lines) contains no resolver/search call. Severity P1 upheld: this is the one finding in the set that can point the mount at the wrong sky for a whole night while the UI affirmatively says the target is set.
